description.value: Cassini Cellars is a boutique estate winery situated on the Golden Mile Bench—described on its own site as the finest grape-growing region in Canada—halfway between Oliver and Osoyoos on Highway 97. The winery has accumulated an impressive awards haul including Lieutenant Governor's Awards of Excellence, Double Golds at the Canadian Wine Championship, and a Platinum at Wine Press Northwest, making it one of the most decorated small producers in the South Okanagan. Cyclists riding the popular Okanagan wine-route corridor will pass directly in front of the property on HWY97 and can stop at the tasting room to sample celebrated Cabernet Franc, Malbec, and other estate reds.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched from cassini.ca and provides the physical address (4828 HWY97, Oliver, BC V0H 1T0) and phone (250-485-4370) not present in OSM, confirming the business is a real winery on the Golden Mile Bench. A front-page notice states the tasting room re-opened April 20, 2026; since today is May 25, 2026, the business is confirmed open. No website content mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities, so all WWC required criteria and optional amenities remain null.
